capabilities: List embedded images, SVGs, PDFs, videos, audio and tables of the current note in a sidebar
Jump to an item in the note by clicking its card
Drag cards into notes to insert embed links, keeping PDF page anchors
Filter the list by media kind and resize card thumbnails
Open files in tabs, splits, the system file manager, or the browser
extras: Not reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop-only actions: showing files in Finder/Explorer and dragging cards into notes. Known limitations: embedded notes, Canvas files and other plugins' generated content are not listed; some multi-line HTML media tags and unescaped Markdown embed addresses are not detected.
motivation: The README implies the pain ('finding one again means scrolling') but gives no explicit author motivation.
problem: Long notes accumulate embedded figures, tables, PDFs and recordings, and finding a specific one again means scrolling through the note.

relations.evidence: BRAT can install pre-releases from adalach/obsidian-note-media-navigator.

summary: Sidebar pane that lists the figures, tables, PDFs, videos and audio embedded in the current note, with previews and click-to-jump navigation.
